document.name: Adjustable Desktop Fan with 608 Axle Bearing
document.description: Compact personal desktop fan featuring an exposed three-blade rotor, open-front circular safety cage, tilted yoke stand, rotary speed knob, and a sourced 608 ball bearing supporting the 8 mm main drive axle.

steps.title: Base & PWM Speed Control
steps.description: Place the PWM speed controller PCB inside the weighted desktop base and press the knurled aluminum speed knob onto the vertical potentiometer shaft.

steps.title: Tilt Yoke & Motor Pod
steps.description: Mount the U-shaped tilt yoke to the base pedestal, position the vented motor housing at its 12-degree upward tilt, and secure both side trunnions with the locking thumb knobs.

steps.title: Motor, Axle & Sourced 608 Bearing
steps.description: Install the brushless DC motor inside the housing, slide the 8 mm stainless drive axle through the motor, and press the sourced 608 ball bearing (8 mm bore, 22 mm OD) into the front nose boss.

steps.title: Circular Grille & Exposed Three-Blade Rotor
steps.description: Fasten the open-front circular safety grille around the motor pod and press the high-visibility three-blade rotor hub onto the protruding 8 mm axle in front of the 608 bearing.

relationships.description: Weighted base encloses the PWM motor speed controller PCB.
Knurled aluminum speed knob couples to the potentiometer shaft on the control PCB.
PWM controller delivers variable-duty DC power through the yoke cable to the brushless motor.
U-shaped tilt yoke bolts rigidly to the top pedestal of the weighted base.
Tilt yoke cradles the motor housing side trunnions at a 12-degree upward angle.
Threaded thumb knobs clamp the yoke arms against the motor housing trunnions to lock the tilt angle.
Vented rear motor pod houses the brushless DC stator and rotor.
Front 22 mm nose pocket of the motor housing seats the outer race of the sourced 608 ball bearing.
Brushless DC motor drives the 8 mm stainless steel fan axle.
Sourced 608 bearing supports the 8 mm fan axle with low-friction rolling contact.
Front end of the 8 mm axle press-fits into the exposed three-blade rotor hub.
Circular safety grille mounts to the motor housing perimeter and pivot bosses.

mechanisms.name: Fan Speed & Rotor Spin
mechanisms.description: Rotates the front speed knob and drives the 8 mm fan axle and exposed three-blade rotor on the 608 bearing.

stages.title: Minimum Speed
stages.description: The knurled speed knob is at its low-speed stop while the rotor begins turning.

stages.title: PWM Ramp-Up
stages.description: Turning the speed knob increases PWM duty cycle to the brushless DC motor, accelerating the 8 mm axle through the 608 bearing.

stages.title: Full Airflow
stages.description: The exposed three-blade rotor spins smoothly inside the circular perimeter grille at full speed.

rounds.summary: The desktop fan design satisfies all visual and structural requirements across the assembled, top, and exploded views. It features a compact desktop base with a clearly visible knurled speed knob, a U-shaped tilt yoke with side thumb locking knobs supporting a 12-degree upward-tilted motor pod, a circular open-front safety grille framing an exposed orange three-blade rotor, and a sourced 608 ball bearing mounted coaxially on the 8 mm drive axle.

observations.detail: The assembled view shows a complete, compact desktop fan assembly (~174 mm width by ~225 mm height) with a weighted circular base stand, U-shaped support yoke, motor housing, circular cage, and rotor.

The assembled and top views show the exposed orange three-blade rotor at the open front of the circular rear and perimeter safety grille, cradled by the U-shaped tilt yoke and side tilt locking thumb knobs at a 12-degree upward tilt angle.

The knurled speed knob with an orange position indicator is clearly visible on the front of the weighted base stand in both assembled and top views, and aligns over the internal PWM speed controller PCB potentiometer in the exploded view.

The exploded view clearly reveals the sourced 608 Axle Ball Bearing (22 mm outer diameter, 8 mm bore, 7 mm width) aligned coaxially on the 8 mm Stainless Drive Axle between the tilted motor pod front boss and the three-blade rotor hub.
